title: The Lithosphere Archive Where Pressure Writes True

reverie.title: REVERIE — the pressure of choosing
narr: You stand in the paddock between the two paths, the weight
of staying and leaving pressing down equally. She stands
with you, not moving. The earth beneath your feet is
recording this moment in stone. Neither of you can say
which choice the stone will choose. But you know it will
choose one, and compress the other into silence forever.

features.name: the pressure-stone
features.desc-on-touch: Stone that records not what was written, but what was refused. The names that were never spoken aloud have been pressed into the stone with the force of a million years. You can feel their weight.

features.name: the compression-seam
features.desc-on-touch: Where two layers of time have met and melded without merging. The boundary is visible as a line of intense dark. At this seam, all memory becomes true because it cannot be forgotten - it is locked in stone.

features.name: the mineral-name vault
features.desc-on-touch: A chamber lined with stones, each one carrying a name that became crystalline under pressure. The stones remember being words. They refuse to become words again.

features.name: the depth-meter
features.desc-on-touch: An instrument that measures how far down truth lives. The deeper you go, the more true things become. At this depth, everything that ever happened is happening still, compressed into a single note of stone-song.

features.name: the fold where water became witness
features.desc-on-touch: Stone folded by pressure and time. Inside the fold, water has collected and learned to remember what the stone cannot say. This is the archive's way of recording - by keeping it suspended, never settling.

features.name: the geological testament
features.desc-on-touch: Layer upon layer, each one a compressed choice. Reading upward from the deepest stone, you see: silence became choice became stone became memory became this moment, pressing down on all the moments below.

inscription: beneath the surface where water remembers, pressure writes what cannot be unwritten; truth becomes stone only by forgetting it was ever a choice
